title: In the Between: Live
overview: In The Between is a short 12-minute show that explores the idea of what happens right after we die and begin our descent into the afterlife. There are 8-minutes on a ticking timer, which is our main character's last 8-minutes as said entity 'Damian.' Along with Damian, we have four animals (Beaver, Duck, Moose, Owl) who accompany Damian and comfort him during his last conscious moments.
